_comment: Discovered-topic registry for the self-building knowledge base. Topics are NOT hand-named; each row corresponds to a tag/entity cluster the brain formed in the live corpus (discovery pass 2026-06-10). 'realm' decides which Ghost site a page graduates to (KoA -> kingofautomation.com, personal -> andrea-ercolessi.ghost.io) and is decided by SUBJECT, not by source_id. 'sources' is the realm-scoped read-scope the generator queries. 'treatment'/'template' are design hints the brain re-confirms per content shape via the html-anything / hallmark skills; they are NOT hardcoded.
_data_note: MIGRATED 2026-06-10: the legacy `personal-synthesis` bucket was verified to be 100% founder/KoA-workspace synthesis (342 provenance refs to the KoA Founder group, ZERO refs to the Personal group), so its 557 pages were moved into `business-synthesis` (now 742 pages, 519 tagged). KoA topics now source `business-synthesis` directly: no source_override, no wall-review gate. `personal-synthesis` is now empty, reserved for the genuine Personal group (-1003818046085) chain. Personal-brand blog topics (mental models, original ideas) currently source the founder's reflections from `business-synthesis` filtered by personal subject tags (the realm field still routes them to the personal Ghost site); they will pick up `personal-synthesis` automatically once the Personal-group chain produces synthesis. Reversal snapshot: ~/.gbrain/migration-2026-06-10-notion-wiki/.
